native_contracts.finding: Checks actual MetamagicData and UnitPartSpecialMetamagic; inventory ownership alone is not evidence of Reach.
Reach uses SystemMechanics.RayWeapon; ordinary physical touch uses TouchWeapon. Sticky source spells delegate to their native touch-delivery ability.
A negative count is unlimited after both charges and resource limits. The low-value Pure Mage fallback requires an actual unlimited level-zero book spell without an item or spent material.
Stores ordered Spell1/Spell2, selected delivery, save, school, target type, native level, touch and additional-area configuration. Metadata snapshots include all of these fields.
One selected shared save, then the ordered concatenated source RunAction payloads, with sticky-touch RunAction fallback. Source spells are not separately cast.
Use selected fusion delivery, with an optional separate additional-AoE path; empty default-slot targeting flags do not describe the created spell.
Reuses the fusion shared save unless MakeSaveAlsoForMagicHack requests another save or the context has no save.
Damage/stat-damage dice use the live spellbook MagicHackSpellbookComponent cap. DrainEnergy builds its own dice from Value. Per-action HalfIfSaved and conditional-save branches determine outcomes.
Reads native per-level component data, rather than an AI cap table. Supplied MagicDeceiverSpellbook values are 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 100; level six is not literally unlimited.
Native UI writes created fusions as custom spells; existing shared discovery already enumerates them. Identity and profile interpretation needed repair.
Weapon restrictions, live active buff context and positive simple/rank energy dice are required. Unknown conditional/random/custom-value shapes do not authorize physical fallback.
The inspected native familiar contract spawns a visual familiar, not a controllable touch-delivery unit. No fabricated familiar cast or success probability added.

Reads the selected delivery components and separately applies each source clicked-target secondary component. Those secondary payloads are explicitly outside the initial supported forecast; no unpriced secondary footprint is admitted.

blueprint_scope: C06_NATIVE_COMPATIBLE_SCOPE.json; original full corpus retains its previously fingerprinted single enum failure
